_comment: Released stable species ids — APPEND-ONLY (ADR-0006, 12r-a). The append-only-ids eval fails if any id here disappears from game-core/content/species/*.ron, and — since 12r-a — also fails if a LIVE id is not pinned here. Derived by reading the RON by hand in glob-sorted filename order (000-core.ron: 1, 2, 3 · 010-derived.ron: 4, 5, 6 · 020-playtest-wave1.ron: 7, 8, 9, 10 · 050-wave2.ron: 20, 21 · 051-wave2-derived.ron: 22, 23 · 060-item-evo-derived.ron: 30, 31 = 16 ids), then cross-checked against parseIds — NEVER generated from parseIds, because a baseline derived from the extractor under test is self-confirming and forbidden. AUTHOR OBLIGATION: a content PR that adds a species id MUST append it here in the SAME PR; this list may only ever GROW, never shrink (a per-registry baseline floor in the eval enforces that a shrink cannot pass by agreeing with a content deletion). SCOPE LIMIT — this gate detects id REMOVAL and UNPINNED GROWTH only, NEVER id REUSE or rebinding: swapping 20 and 21, or reusing id 20 for an entirely different creature, stays green (catching that needs a map-shaped baseline like evolution-path-edge-ids.json — a named follow-up). parseIds is also flat and depth-blind, so introducing a nested `id:` sub-record inside a species entry would be a breaking change for this gate.
